master: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic mechanical keyboard key for MykTech's premium black, white and muted-gold IT studio website. Isolated transparent background, square canvas. A large sculpted square onyx-black PBT keycap with softly rounded corners and a shallow concave top, mounted on a compact smoked translucent mechanical switch with a subtle brass contact plate. Elevated three-quarter studio view, top face clearly visible, front and right sides visible, object centered and fills 78% of canvas with comfortable transparent margins, no ground plane. The WEB DEVELOPMENT icon is a simple browser window outline with a small pair of code angle brackets inside. This icon is physically laser engraved INTO the keycap top and filled with warm brushed champagne-gold metal: flush inlay, subtle bevel catching light, follows the top face's perspective and curvature. Beautiful satin material, controlled softbox highlights that reveal the black silhouette, crisp product photography, restrained warmth. One key only, one icon only. No floating graphics, no circular badge behind icon, no holograms, no glowing outline, no extra symbols, no letters or words, no watermark, no dramatic smoke, no cast background. Real alpha transparency.

The new symbol must be physically engraved, flush brushed champagne-gold metal inlay, matching the original line weight and footprint and following exactly the perspective and gentle curvature of the top face. Preserve the identical keycap geometry, mechanical switch, object size, position, three-quarter camera angle, black PBT grain, light direction, highlights, sharpness, square framing, and transparent margins. ONE key, ONE icon, no extra decoration, no letters or text, no circular badge, no floating graphics, no glow. Keep background genuinely transparent with the original alpha silhouette.
